primary_hypothesis.physical_signature: Multi-scale (sigma=2.5, 5.0 px) Cordell-Grauch Poisson pseudogravity-to-gravity horizontal gradient anti-concordance (1 - cos angle(grad_H g_iso, grad_H PG(RTP))) gated by basement depth step (|grad_H depth_to_base_surf|), Gallardo-Meju cross-gradient rotational ridges, gravity-normal basement profile inflection, missing-coverage-aware 1 m LiDAR down-facing piedmont scarp-toe curvature dipole bridged by 100 m DEM ridges, kinematic transtensional strain x swarm excess, and DOE GDR 1391 chemical geothermometer disequilibrium conduits, coupled with fold-visible 12-bit Leave-Own-Component-Out (LOCO) transfer-relay mechanics and 300 m submodular kernel cover.
primary_hypothesis.why_uncatalogued: Mapped USGS/INGENIOUS Quaternary faults are predominantly steep range-front bedrock scarps. Intrabasin accommodation transfer faults, piedmont step-out splays (200 m-3 km basinward of range fronts), and argillic-altered hydrothermal conduits have subdued or buried surface scarps missed by legacy mapping, but retain strong subsurface density-vs-magnetization Poisson decoupling (dense weakly-magnetic basement juxtaposed against magnetic volcanic fill, or hydrothermal magnetite destruction along fluid conduits) and subtle piedmont scarp-toe breaklines.
primary_hypothesis.named_non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted erosional margins of reversely magnetized Tertiary ash-flow tuffs lapping onto dense Paleozoic carbonate basement, pluvial Lake Lahontan wave-cut shoreline terraces overlying buried pluton contacts, or highway/railroad embankments across flat basin floors.

experiments.description: Feature synthesis, single-feature symmetric ROC-AUC leakage canaries on Seed 30 and Seed 20 (stop if any > 0.90), Phase-1 pre-placement surface Spearman correlation scan against registry/local rasters (stop if |rho| > 0.90), and standalone label-free surface screen on gems57-pooled-hide-v2.

Dual-seed buffered whole-component spatial holdout evaluation (gems57-pooled-hide-v2, Seed 30: 11,342 withheld positives; Seed 20: 11,321 withheld positives) comparing A_pcd_full (static + LOCO + 300m submodular), A_pcd_greedy (same surface + greedy disk), A_pcd_static_only (no LOCO), A_pcd_mech_only, A_std_greedy (standard 19-band + terrain + rad control), and A0_random, with 1,000-draw paired block-bootstrap 95% CIs.

Full-map 4-quadrant strictly out-of-fold H83-PCD surface build, sparse-overlap-capped 37,654-dot 300 m submodular emission (0 pixels copied, 0 SGMC channels), shared submission_writer.py packaging + 15/15 validator & 17/17 independent readback checks, Phase-2 final-dot uniqueness audit (reporting both sparse informative pass <= 0.70 and literal Policy I17 dense-witness stop), and frozen JSON run card.
